findings.title: Shard-split queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() already maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables() (shardQuerySplitting.ts:52) because it needs the interpolated selector to fetch __stream_shard__ values, and splitQueriesByStreamShard() then executes each shard group via runSplitQuery() (shardQuerySplitting.ts:163), which now maps the same targets through applyTemplateVariables() again at this line. Template replacement is therefore applied twice to every sharded query (the updated shard test even expects 5 calls for 1 target: 1 up-front plus 1 per shard sub-request). This is not guaranteed idempotent: applyTemplateVariables also injects request.filters (adhoc filters) into the expr, so the second pass can duplicate label matchers/line filters in the LogQL sent to Loki (duplicate matchers in a stream selector can be rejected), and variable values introduced by the first pass that contain '$...' sequences can be re-expanded against the sub-request. The shard path needs a way to tell runSplitQuery() that its targets are already interpolated (or to not pre-interpolate beyond what shard grouping requires) instead of interpolating unconditionally.
